text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Superficial and foolish! Shallow and 
untalented! Good grief, what an absolute 
blunder...!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, Trainer. Please leave me alone 
for now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I have no right to face you...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
And to think it was a masterpiece…… that I 
only just came up with last night……!!
